headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 18, 2026**
article:
The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-1 victory behind Nolan McLean's 7.0 innings of work with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. The Kansas City Royals took down the Washington Nationals 6-2, with Luinder Avila earning the win after 5.2 innings and Carter Jensen leading the offense with a 4-hit performance, including a home run.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams, with several key players sidelined. The Chicago White Sox placed RF Everson Pereira on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion. The Kansas City Royals placed LHP Cole Ragans on the 60-day injured list with left elbow impingement. The Atlanta Braves transferred RHP Spencer Strider from the 15-day to the 60-day injured list with right elbow inflammation. The Cleveland Guardians placed RF Chase DeLauter on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 14 with a right side rib fracture.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Seattle Mariners trading RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash. The Toronto Blue Jays traded C Tyler Heineman to the Los Angeles Angels for cash, while the Kansas City Royals traded RHP Denis Samudio and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for RHP Connor Seabold. The Seattle Mariners also traded RHP Yosver Zulueta to the Chicago Cubs for cash.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Reds 9-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing a 9-1 victory. Nolan McLean led the way on the mound, pitching 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Royals Take Down Nationals 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a 6-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Luinder Avila earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. Carter Jensen led the Royals' offense with a 4-hit performance, including a home run.

top_news.title: **Marlins Rout Phillies 12-4**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Philadelphia Phillies, securing a 12-4 victory. Kyle Stowers led the Marlins' offense with a 4-hit, 2-home run performance, driving in 5 runs.

top_news.title: **Giants Take Down Braves in Thrilling 7-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants secured a 7-2 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Jung Hoo Lee leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. Robbie Ray earned the win with 6.1 innings pitched, striking out eight and allowing no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, with a strong performance from their lineup. Impact hitters for the Blue Jays included George Springer, Vladimir Guerrero Jr., Nathan Lukes, and Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Brewers 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 4-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, led by strong performances from impact hitters Travis Bazzana and David Fry. Parker Messick also made a notable contribution on the mound for the winning team.

top_news.title: **White Sox Place Everson Pereira on 7-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Everson Pereira, the Chicago White Sox right fielder, has been placed on the 7-day injured list due to a concussion.

top_news.title: **Mariners Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners traded RHP Randy Dobnak to the Kansas City Royals for cash on June 17, 2026.
